metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects ATT&CK technique T1132.001 (Standard Encoding). Adversaries may encode data with a standard data encoding system to make the content of command and control traffic more difficult to detect. Command and control (C2) information can be encoded using
properties.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where NewProcessName contains "mitre" or CommandLine contains "t1132" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Account, NewProcessName | where count_ > 5 // AZ-MITRE-ATTACK-037
